from.place: Proof, sentence on adjunction units and counits and their coefficient comparisons: Ordinary scalar restriction with section-normalized comparisons; localized open-extension clause, preservation of ordinary open support

title: Scalar restriction preserves support of an ordinary open extension
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in Type (u+1), j:U -> X an open immersion of schemes in universe u, and a: B_X -> A_X any morphism of the constant ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site of X. For every A_U-module sheaf M, restrict scalars on the chosen extension moduleJ A j M through a. The counit of the specified B-coefficient open-extension adjunction, evaluated at this restricted sheaf, is an isomorphism. Here moduleJ and moduleJAdj are the actual chosen left adjoint and adjunction of def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension, and restriction is the unchanged-section functor of def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars. There are no flatness or nonempty-open hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero), Tag 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), and Tag 03DJ; restriction of scalar action in the explicit localized direct-sum extension

proof.text: Identify the small pro-etale site of U with the localization of the site of X at the subterminal object j. Under the ringed localized-site equivalence, the specified pullback is restriction. Its chosen left adjoint is therefore identified, by adjoint uniqueness, with the sheafification of the localized extension presheaf. This identification applies separately to the constant A and B coefficient sheaves.

source.place: Tag 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero), Tag 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), and Tag 03DJ; restriction of scalar action in the explicit localized direct-sum extension

proof.text: Restrict the coefficient map a to the localized site. At each H the extension presheaf is the direct sum of the localized sections over arrows H to U. Restricting the A-action along a changes neither these abelian groups, nor their restrictions, nor the direct-sum inclusions. Identity on each summand is B-linear and gives an isomorphism from the scalar restriction of the A-extension presheaf to the B-extension presheaf of the scalar restriction of the localized A-module. Sheafification extends this identity isomorphism: scalar restriction leaves the underlying additive sheafification unchanged, and the extended B-actions agree by uniqueness.

source.place: Tag 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero), Tag 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), and Tag 03DJ; restriction of scalar action in the explicit localized direct-sum extension

proof.text: It follows that the scalar restriction of moduleJ A j M belongs to the essential image of moduleJ B j. Extension by zero along the subterminal open is fully faithful: its unit is identity after localization. The triangle identity makes its counit invertible on this essential image. Transport this invertibility through the adjoint-uniqueness identifications to the specified moduleJAdj B j counit. The empty open gives zero objects and the identity open gives identity functors, so neither case requires a nonemptiness hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictScalars_openCounit_isIso
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (a : coefficients B X ⟶ coefficients A X)
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (M : Modules A U) :
    IsIso ((moduleJAdj.{u} B j).counit.app
      ((Scheme.proEtaleRingRestrictScalars a).obj
        ((moduleJ.{u} A j).obj M)))
